description: On the green-covered table there are sorted piles of colorful beads, a black tape dispenser, a red string off to the left, and a purple-and-white beaded strand in front of the hands. The left hand holds the end of the beaded strand steady while the right hand repeatedly pinches a single bead from the nearby pile, brings it down to the strand’s tip, and slides it onto the string, then briefly lifts away to pick up the next bead.
